title: Bundle Footer Command Tabs Into Command Toggle
description: Bundle all the inlined command category tabs in the footer (bottom-middle panel root tabs) into one expandable Command toggle, matching the Display branch pattern so only Command shows when folded and categories reveal on expand.
summary: Bundled bottom-middle command category leaves under one expandable Command branch (framework.category.command), matching Display. Folded chrome now shows a single Command toggle; categories reveal on expand. Updated palette redirects and category-switch collapse to the two-segment path, added ui.panelToggle.command (EN/DE), and covered the path shape in framework tests.
